title: A walk through Old Riga from St Peter’s Church to the Monument of Freedom
description: A walk through the old town from St. Peter’s Church past Town Hall Square and Dome Square to the Freedom Monument, with stories along the way, including Riga’s claim to the first decorated Christmas tree.

title: Riga’s Architecture: The World’s Art Nouveau Capital
description: A short walk from the art museum along Elizabetes iela to Alberta iela, the street with the most famous Art Nouveau facades in Riga.

title: Latvian Legends and History in Riga’s Old Town
description: A walk from Albert Square, where Riga began, through the oldest part of the old town, with Latvian legends and history along the way.
